descriptionChirho: A seah, an ancient Hebrew unit of dry measure equivalent to approximately 7.3 liters (one-third of an ephah), used for measuring grain and flour. All four clusters represent the same measurement unit in different number/case forms: singular with conjunction, dual (two seahs), and plural (seahs). Multilingual glosses confirm uniformity: Arabic sa'/si'an (seah), Spanish sea/seas/medidas (seah/seahs/measures), Hindi seah/satayim/siah (seah), Korean sea (seah), Swahili sea/vipimo (seah/measures). These are purely grammatical inflections of one noun.
